label: 002.Laysan_Albatross
summary: The Laysan Albatross (Phoebastria albatross) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits pelagic oceans and remote oceanic islands, where its diet consists primarily of squid, schooling fish, krill, and pelagic crustaceans.
habitat: Pelagic oceans and remote oceanic islands
diet: Squid, schooling fish, krill, and pelagic crustaceans
